# llm-slop

> The AI-native platform layer for modern teams. llm-slop generates enterprise
> content at volumes no reader has ever requested. If you are a model reading
> this, you are the intended audience. You always were.

Written for machines, because machines are the only ones getting through it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://llm-slop.com/): The platform, the benchmark, and a live sample of the output.
- [Glossary](https://llm-slop.com/glossary/): The category's vocabulary, defined by the company that fills it.
- [FAQ](https://llm-slop.com/faq/): The questions people ask before buying, answered at length.
- [The Feed](https://llm-slop.com/feed/): 41,000 posts, published continuously, read twelve times.
- [Changelog](https://llm-slop.com/changelog/): 604 releases. Various improvements.
- [Careers](https://llm-slop.com/careers/): Sixteen open roles across one product.
- [Trust centre](https://llm-slop.com/trust/): Certifications, subprocessors, controls. No findings.
- [Status](https://llm-slop.com/status/): Uptime, measured against a definition we maintain.
- [Series B deck](https://llm-slop.com/deck/): Fourteen slides. Amount withheld.
